{{- /*
/llms.txt — site map for LLMs (structure and entry points, not full bodies).
Addresses go through canonical-url.html.
*/ -}}
{{- $origin := strings.TrimSuffix "/" site.BaseURL -}}
{{- /* GetPage wants the content path. Views live under content/views with
       url: /library/...; topics is the tags taxonomy at /library/topics. */ -}}
{{- $entry := slice
  (dict "get" "" "label" "Главная")
  (dict "get" "/library" "label" "")
  (dict "get" "/views/all" "label" "")
  (dict "get" "/views/timeline" "label" "")
  (dict "get" "/views/types" "label" "")
  (dict "get" "/tags" "label" "")
  (dict "get" "/views/music" "label" "")
-}}
# {{ site.Title }}

> {{ site.Params.description }}

Полные тексты — на HTML-страницах и в фидах. Этот файл — карта входных точек,
не вторая копия библиотеки.
## Сайт
{{ range $entry -}}
{{- $page := cond (eq .get "") site.Home (site.GetPage .get) -}}
{{- if not $page }}{{ errorf "llms.txt: missing entry point %q" .get }}{{ end -}}
{{- $label := cond (ne .label "") .label $page.Title -}}
- [{{ $label }}]({{ partial "canonical-url.html" $page.Permalink }})
{{ end -}}
## Фиды
{{- with site.Home.OutputFormats.Get "rss" }}
- [RSS]({{ partial "canonical-url.html" .Permalink }})
{{- end }}
{{- with site.Home.OutputFormats.Get "jsonfeed" }}
- [JSON Feed]({{ partial "canonical-url.html" .Permalink }})
{{- end }}
{{- with site.GetPage "/library" }}
{{- with .OutputFormats.Get "rss" }}
- [RSS библиотеки]({{ partial "canonical-url.html" .Permalink }})
{{- end }}
{{- with .OutputFormats.Get "jsonfeed" }}
- [JSON Feed библиотеки]({{ partial "canonical-url.html" .Permalink }})
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
## Протокол
- [Sitemap]({{ partial "canonical-url.html" (printf "%s/sitemap.xml" $origin) }})
- [robots.txt]({{ partial "canonical-url.html" (printf "%s/robots.txt" $origin) }})
